general_information.Description: -Students will learn the essential skills of portfolio management and personal investing, learn how to think about, discuss, and formulate solutions to common investor's questions, issues: how to meet their liabilities, how to decide where to invest, and how much risk to take on. Students will learn the theory and the real-world skills necessary to design, execute, and evaluate investment proposals that meet financial objectives. -Students will then learn how to construct optimal portfolios that manage risk effectively, and how to capitalize on understanding behavioral biases and irrational behavior in financial markets. Students will learn the best practices in portfolio management and performance evaluation as well as current investment strategies. By the end of Capstone Project, students will have mastered the analytical tools, quantitative skills, and practical knowledge necessary for long-term investment management success. Note: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 3. Keep online learning progress promptly. 4. Communicate and discuss in forum 5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (Optional) 6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus
